faqs.q: How do I apply for a conveyancer licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a conveyancer licence depending on whether you are an individual or a corporation.

faqs.q: What if I need to change details on my conveyancer licence?
faqs.a: There are specific processes for changing details on a conveyancer licence, depending on whether you are an individual or a corporation.

faqs.q: Can I renew or restore my conveyancer licence?
faqs.a: Yes, you can renew or restore your licence, with separate processes for individuals and corporations.

faqs.q: How can I check a property conveyancer licence?
faqs.a: You can check a property conveyancer licence using the dedicated service.
